name: Browserless
description: Self-hosted headless browser automation server (Puppeteer, Playwright, and CDP) supporting Chrome, Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, and Multi-engine images.
short_desc: Headless browser automation server (Chrome, Chromium, Firefox, WebKit, Multi)
author: Browserless

form_fields.label: BROWSERLESS_IMAGE
form_fields.hint: Select the official Browserless v2 browser image to run (Edge and SDK do not publish public GHCR packages). Default: chrome.

form_fields.label: shm_size
form_fields.hint: Shared memory (/dev/shm) size (e.g. 2gb). Leave blank to use Docker's native default (64m), equivalent to omitting shm_size.

form_fields.label: MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS
form_fields.hint: Maximum number of concurrent browser sessions (e.g. 10). Leave blank to create the container without this environment variable.

form_fields.label: CONNECTION_TIMEOUT
form_fields.hint: Maximum session timeout in milliseconds (e.g. 60000). Leave blank to create the container without this environment variable.

form_fields.label: PREBOOT_CHROME
form_fields.hint: Keep prebooted browser instances ready (true or false). Leave blank to create the container without this environment variable.

form_fields.label: CHROME_REFRESH_TIME
form_fields.hint: Interval in milliseconds to restart idle browser processes (e.g. 3600000). Leave blank to create the container without this environment variable.

form_fields.label: ENABLE_CORS
form_fields.hint: Enable CORS headers on HTTP responses (true or false). Leave blank to create the container without this environment variable.

form_fields.label: DEMOING
form_fields.hint: Enable or disable demo mode (false or true). Leave blank to create the container without this environment variable.
